Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: The latest release, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Checking the release history, the most recent version that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed and v2.3.0 is now rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** (on-call paged) describing the health check failures on v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0. Note: the first incident creation attempt timed out, so I verified no duplicate incident existed before retrying with an idempotency key.

Recommended follow-up: investigate the root cause of v2.3.1's failures before attempting to redeploy it.
